description: Start a fine-tuning job (OpenAI's /fine_tuning/jobs shape) that trains a LoRA or QLoRA adapter on an open base model and names the result with an ft: id, or quote it with dry_run: true. method: "lora" or "qlora" as a string, or OpenAI's {"type": "supervised", "supervised": {"adapter": "lora", "hyperparameters": {...}}} or {"type": "dpo", "dpo": {"hyperparameters": {"beta": ...}}}. Hyperparameters (n_epochs, batch_size, learning_rate_multiplier, lora_rank, lora_alpha, max_seq_length) go in hyperparameters or inside method, once. Costs credit: a fine-tune is charged per 1M trained tokens (training tokens × epochs) at the base model's published fine-tuning price, with the per-job minimum (https://gridlinegpu.com/pricing). When the job starts, its maximum possible cost is held from your credit and the unused part is returned when it ends; a job your credit cannot cover does not start (insufficient_quota). The created job object carries Gridline's quote (an upper bound). Jobs stopped by a platform fault or the time limit are not charged. Creating a job starts it, so send dry_run: true first: it runs the same checks and returns the same quote (object fine_tuning.job.quote, with quote.per_token.max_charge_usd and credit_check) and creates nothing. Requires confirm_spend: true unless dry_run is true.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true for this call to run: you have read the quote or price and accept the charge.

dry_run.description: true: return the quote and the credit check only; nothing is created or charged.

method.description: "lora", "qlora", or an OpenAI method object (supervised or dpo).

model.description: Base model id, e.g. qwen2.5-7b-instruct (see list_models).

suffix.description: A short label in the ft: model name.

training_file.description: File id of the training data (purpose fine-tune).

name: create_fine_tune
title: Create a fine-tuning job
